purpose: Owner answer to approved roadmap and testable execution coverage, not implementation/live proof

entries.subject: Base refurbished offers and hidden prelaunch pricing
entries.decision: $35 per washer/dryer; $60 per pair only as approved private starting values; no public publication
entries.acceptance: Quote/test reconciles exact discounted item total; public web price remains hidden

entries.subject: Two machine identities and explicit set discount
entries.decision: Two individually tracked machines; explicit $10 pair discount at $35 each, never opaque set price
entries.acceptance: Statement, agreement, inventory, and invoice allocate each machine without duplicate discount

entries.subject: Partial return of discounted pair
entries.decision: Credit undelivered future coverage of removed machine at allocated paid discounted share, never retro-reprice prepaid coverage
entries.acceptance: Mid-cycle/fully prepaid/term-discount tests and no double credit

entries.subject: Prepaid annual coverage preserved
entries.decision: Protect existing 12-month prepayment and free-month terms; unused returning unit credits original paid basis
entries.acceptance: Prepaid invoice/date and end-period allocations reconcile to immutable signed cents

entries.subject: Customer-specific discounts and owner overrides
entries.decision: Reasoned OWNER pricing override, reviewable discount with tax recalculation; signed frozen amounts immutable
entries.acceptance: Multi-address discount/override audit and cents identity

entries.subject: Per-location administrative setup
entries.decision: One $45 initial setup per new delivery location with explicit FULL/PARTIAL/WAIVED owner decision and reason
entries.acceptance: One fee per location, no duplicate sibling charge, tax fail-closed

entries.subject: Existing-location add-ons
entries.decision: No automatic setup charge on active-address add-on; explicit owner exception supported
entries.acceptance: Active/nonactive and same-location idempotence

entries.subject: Relocation priced by job
entries.decision: Default $75 per relocation job, regardless of machine count; owner approval and waiver; no second administrative setup
entries.acceptance: Multi-machine relocation charge occurs once with documented actor

entries.subject: Local free-delivery band
entries.decision: Driving distance 0 to 15 miles inclusive, delivery $0; separate setup remains
entries.acceptance: 15.000 boundary and all-in fee disclosure

entries.subject: Mid-distance delivery band
entries.decision: Driving distance greater than 15 to 30 miles inclusive; configurable $75, waiveable
entries.acceptance: 15+ epsilon and 30-mile boundary tests

entries.subject: Outer delivery band
entries.decision: Driving distance greater than 30 to 50 miles inclusive; configurable $125, quote-led
entries.acceptance: 30+ epsilon and 50-mile boundary tests

entries.subject: Beyond fifty miles switch
entries.decision: Over 50 miles OFF at launch; future owner toggle and reviewed manual quote only
entries.acceptance: No price, checkout or appointment before explicit expansion approval

entries.subject: Driving-distance eligibility resolver
entries.decision: Editable Greeley reference point; verified driving route, not ZIP radius; provider failure -> manual review
entries.acceptance: Distance-source evidence, cache policy, outage and change-of-origin tests

entries.subject: Delivery marketing and fee transparency
entries.decision: Only approved free-local message; actual all-in fees align quote/agreement/signing
entries.acceptance: Marketing omission, mandatory fee snapshot and cross-channel comparison tests

entries.subject: Household security deposit policy
entries.decision: No ordinary household deposit; never silently collect reserve
entries.acceptance: Household quote and signing have no deposit line

entries.subject: First-month down payment for large accounts
entries.decision: 5+ machines OR business/property manager: first-month amount at signing, credited once at first delivery invoice
entries.acceptance: Exactly-once invoice credit and no revenue double count

entries.subject: Negotiated refundable commercial reserve
entries.decision: Separate liability ledger, approved amount/terms/deductions; quarterly configurable top-up after shortfall
entries.acceptance: Liability vs revenue postings, holds, refund approvals, balance replay

entries.subject: Ordinary pre-delivery cancellation
entries.decision: Owner-reviewed full collected-money return regardless of scheduled visit
entries.acceptance: Reconcile setup/down payment/receipt; money-out independently approved

entries.subject: Large-order pre-delivery cancellation
entries.decision: 72-hour configurable refund window; later setup retention recommendation and down-payment refund, owner can override
entries.acceptance: DST/signed-time boundary, partial/full approvals, no duplicate refund

entries.subject: Single late-payment charge and grace
entries.decision: Latest 2026-10-13 decision: five calendar days, one flat $5 day-six charge, reasoned waiver, configurable
entries.acceptance: No fee on days 0-5, once day 6, no compounding/repricing signed contracts

entries.subject: Oldest-obligation-first partial payments
entries.decision: Allocate customer partial receipts oldest due receivable before later items, by stable tie-breaker
entries.acceptance: Partial, held, dispute and retry reconciliation; no double cash

entries.subject: Customer satisfaction survey
entries.decision: Optional email-only survey at most quarterly with rating and optional comment; no launch send authorization
entries.acceptance: Suppression, consent, recurrence, opt-out and no fake customer messages

entries.subject: Customer appointment preferences
entries.decision: Multiple eligible dates and AM/PM requests, clearly NOT BOOKED until staff confirms
entries.acceptance: Requested vs confirmed state, concurrent slot conflict, no auto-book

entries.subject: Telephone and delivery hours separation
entries.decision: 8:00–18:30 daily is phone availability, not delivery schedule; separate owner-configurable windows
entries.acceptance: No phone-hour-driven automatic appointment promise

entries.subject: Inventory acquired gradually
entries.decision: Never seed fictitious machines; each acquisition/serial/receipt recorded when actually owned
entries.acceptance: No inventory or fleet valuation from forecasts

entries.subject: Missed-trip discretionary fee
entries.decision: Default $0/OFF, case-specific owner approval and reason when charged; swaps and business reschedules free
entries.acceptance: No automatic trip charge; invoice audit after explicit decision

entries.subject: Repairs/swaps and hookup consumables
entries.decision: Routine repairs/swaps included; record inspection/reuse/new safety hookups on job, not separate consumables invoice
entries.acceptance: Per-machine hookup evidence and no duplicate fee on ordinary follow-up

entries.subject: Every tenant repair notice to client
entries.decision: Notify actual contracting manager on every tenant maintenance request using verified chosen method
entries.acceptance: At-least-one tracked private client notice; retries and consent respect activation

entries.subject: Misuse/neglect liability evidence
entries.decision: Document separate suspected damage with photographs, factual actor, repair/visit/replacement estimates
entries.acceptance: No damage amount quietly added to rent, tenant isolation

entries.subject: Damage claim review, dispute, collection
entries.decision: Separate 90-day-default dated invoice, client dispute/adjustment; autopay only with separate signed authorization and no open dispute
entries.acceptance: Two-stage approval, due-date time-zone, signed mandate, replay and dispute hold

entries.subject: Former tenant information retention
entries.decision: Default 12 months after move-out, owner-configurable; claims/disputes/legal hold delay eligible erasure
entries.acceptance: Tenant PII purge dry-run/receipt; legal hold; never delete financial evidence

entries.subject: Portfolio spreadsheet onboarding
entries.decision: Validate, dedupe, preview and require explicit SAVE before importing units/contacts
entries.acceptance: CSV injection, tenant scoping, retries, 1k rows, conflict replay

entries.subject: Partner referrals/commissions disabled
entries.decision: OFF at launch; economics, adjustments, payouts and disclosures not yet approved
entries.acceptance: No liability/payout/marketing until separate business and legal decision

entries.subject: Public/reply email support mailbox
entries.decision: support@ is public reply-to; operations inbox stays private; verify true send/reply flow
entries.acceptance: Configuration readback and user-visible alias, no live send without gate

entries.subject: Existing aliases in one Workspace mailbox
entries.decision: Retain ops, chris, leads, support, billing, no-reply, privacy, accounts, dmarc aliases; no paid seat
entries.acceptance: Alias coverage and inbound routing accepted; no fabricated mailbox

entries.subject: Private home/public postal identity
entries.decision: Never publish owner home; compliant public mailing address still unselected; suppress marketing footer until verified
entries.acceptance: Public site/crawled copy no home address and marketing fail-closed

entries.subject: New local Twilio business phone
entries.decision: Select only after owner approves concrete number/provider purchase; private cellphone never public
entries.acceptance: No purchase/port/public number until owner approval

entries.subject: Phone routing and seven-day hours
entries.decision: Owner-configurable 08:00–18:30 Denver 7 days/week with holidays and private forward destination
entries.acceptance: DST/holiday fallback/number owner readback; phone != delivery hours

entries.subject: Approved private voicemail greeting
entries.decision: Editable owner-approved starting words; after hours route privately; no implied recording authorization
entries.acceptance: Greeting test and telephony consent/privacy approval

entries.subject: Voicemail retention and legal holds
entries.decision: 90-day default, editable; restricted media, eligible purge, retention evidence and holds
entries.acceptance: 365-day time jump, purge, legal hold, access isolation

entries.subject: Transcription and call recording disabled
entries.decision: Voicemail transcription and ordinary recording/transcription OFF independently until approved
entries.acceptance: No capture in default or error path; explicit activation proof

entries.subject: Twilio cost observation/alerts
entries.decision: $20 monthly monitoring, alerts at $10/$15/$20, no automatic communications shutdown; not provider-enforced cap
entries.acceptance: Monthly reset, missing rate warning, no spending mutation

entries.subject: Spanish channels and document quality
entries.decision: Website, account, quote, signature, messages; fluent human review and attorney-approved controlling terms before publish
entries.acceptance: Locale fallback; signed version parity; release off until reviewers approve

entries.subject: Readiness-based November aspiration
entries.decision: No fixed launch date; truthful preparing-to-launch until actual inventory, operations and proof
entries.acceptance: No fabricated public inventory/date; readiness checklist

entries.subject: QuickBooks Free edition preference
entries.decision: Free if actual features/import support; paid compatibility without forced purchase
entries.acceptance: Verify edition limits, owner tenant import and zero-difference proof

entries.subject: Portable journals and export mapping
entries.decision: Audited immutable CSV/journal exports usable for QBO paid edition or alternate CPA system
entries.acceptance: Balanced debits/credits, reproducible exports and import dry run

entries.subject: Business bank selection pending
entries.decision: Bluevine/Axos candidates only, no opened account or bank permissions
entries.acceptance: No bank link/payment without actual account and owner approval

entries.subject: LLC purchases vs personal tools
entries.decision: Company-bought fleet tracked as LLC asset; personal tools not booked without documented transfer
entries.acceptance: Asset ownership/source receipt/account classification

entries.subject: Multiple small owner contributions
entries.decision: Dated distinct equity or documented loan contribution entries, not customer revenue
entries.acceptance: Sum/period books vs funding, transfers are manual

entries.subject: Owner draws/distributions
entries.decision: Dated audit-ready owner distributions separate from expense/payroll; no auto-transfer
entries.acceptance: Contributions/draw net invested, no double spending

entries.subject: Verified opening balances
entries.decision: Only actual cash, assets, payables and liabilities; never invented seed dollars
entries.acceptance: Balanced journal with source reference, reversible correction

entries.subject: Manual sales-tax packet and filing
entries.decision: Prepare and review worksheet; owner independently submits and pays via official portal
entries.acceptance: No site password, automated tax filing or provider payment

entries.subject: AI receipt scanning postponed
entries.decision: OFF/deferred before launch; do not purchase or upload receipt images to AI service
entries.acceptance: No service invocation until later owner approval

entries.subject: Optional ACH payment method
entries.decision: Optional future ACH with signed mandate, delayed settlement and bank proof; recurring debit not preapproved
entries.acceptance: No mandate inferred or bank debit collected by default

entries.subject: Seven-year purchase/tax record retention
entries.decision: Editable baseline seven years after asset fleet exit; CPA/legal holds override purge
entries.acceptance: Asset exit date, retention timer and evidence export

entries.subject: CPA and attorney inputs separated
entries.decision: Configurable provisional defaults for development; explicit owner clearance required to enable affected legal/tax/business use
entries.acceptance: Owner provenance, effective versions, reviewer gates and no LIVE bypass
